You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 4 of 50 (script duration 151.4 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
E3: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
Direct lead-in to E4: Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-1.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.
[L002 1.5-3.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.
[L003 1.5-3.2] ACTION: Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.
[L004 3.2-5.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.
[L005 3.4-4.9] GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant): "Look at him."
[L006 5.0-7.5] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.
[L007 5.0-7.5] GERALD (Scornful): "A penniless nobody for a discarded bride."
[L008 7.6-10.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.
[L009 7.8-9.5] ACTION: Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.
[L010 9.0-10.5] CLARISSA (Gleeful, Condescending): "How fitting."
[L011 10.5-12.0] SCREEN: Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.
[L012 10.6-14.2] CLARISSA (Taunting): "You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are."
[L013 12.0-15.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
[L014 15.0-17.5] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
[L015 15.5-17.5] ACTION: Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
[L016 17.5-21.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.
[L017 20.0-21.8] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling): "You don't even know me."
[L018 21.9-23.4] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
[L019 23.4-25.8] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.
[L020 23.5-25.8] JULIANA (Conflicted, Pained): "You heard what they think I am."
[L021 25.8-27.9] SCREEN: Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.
[L022 25.9-27.7] JULIANA (Searching): "Why would you offer me your name?"
[L023 27.9-30.5] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.
[L024 28.0-30.2] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Certain): "Because I know what I see."
[L025 30.5-32.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
[L026 32.0-33.8] SCREEN: Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.
[L027 32.1-33.7] JULIANA (Quiet, Hesitant): "And what do you see?"
[L028 33.8-36.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.
[L029 34.0-36.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Sincere): "A woman who was betrayed."
[L030 36.0-38.9] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.
[L031 36.5-38.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Resolute): "Not a woman who deserves to be discarded."
[L032 38.9-41.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.
[L033 41.5-45.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana.
[L034 42.0-44.8] JULIANA (Soft, Bitter): "You don't know what my family has done to me."
[L035 45.0-49.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.
[L036 46.0-48.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn): "I know they have made you stand alone."
[L037 49.8-52.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.
[L038 50.0-52.5] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Gentle): "You don't have to stand alone now."
[L039 52.8-55.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.
[L040 53.6-55.8] JULIANA (Defiant, Dignified): "If this is pity, take back your ring."
[L041 55.8-59.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.
[L042 56.8-58.8] JULIANA (Fierce): "I will not become anyone's charity."
[L043 59.0-62.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.
[L044 59.5-62.5] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Earnest): "It is not pity, Lady Juliana."
[L045 62.8-65.8] SCREEN: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.
[L046 63.5-65.5] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Deep, Absolute): "It is a vow."
[L047 65.8-67.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.
[L048 66.0-68.0] JULIANA: "I don't know this man."
[L049 67.5-69.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.
[L050 68.0-69.6] JULIANA: "I don't know what waits beyond these doors."
[L051 69.5-71.8] SCREEN: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.
[L052 69.8-72.0] JULIANA: "But he looked at me when everyone else turned away."
[L053 71.8-74.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.
[L054 72.8-74.5] JULIANA (Resolved): "Then I accept."
[L055 74.8-76.2] SCREEN: Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.
[L056 76.2-79.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.
[L057 76.2-79.0] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.
[L058 79.0-81.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.
[L059 79.2-81.5] ACTION: He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.
[L060 81.8-84.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.
[L061 82.0-83.8] THE PRIEST (Hesitant, Anxious): "My- My Lady..."
[L062 84.0-86.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.
[L063 84.0-85.8] THE PRIEST (Tentative): "Are you certain?"
[L064 86.0-88.8] SCREEN: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
[L065 88.8-91.5] SCREEN: Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.
[L066 89.8-91.0] JULIANA (Unwavering): "I am."
[L067 91.5-94.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.
[L068 92.0-94.5] THE PRIEST (Resigned, Solemn): "Then... let us proceed."
[L069 94.8-97.8] SCREEN: Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.
[L070 95.8-98.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Reassuring): "You need not say anything you do not mean."
[L071 97.8-100.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.
[L072 98.2-100.0] JULIANA (Warm, Sincere): "I truly mean it."
[L073 100.2-102.2] SCREEN: Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.
[L074 100.2-102.2] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
[L075 102.2-105.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.
[L076 102.5-104.2] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn): "You have my protection."
[L077 105.0-107.8] SCREEN: Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.
[L078 105.2-107.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Steadfast): "You have my respect."
[L079 107.8-110.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.
[L080 107.8-109.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave): "And you have my word."
[L081 110.0-112.8] SCREEN: Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.
[L082 110.0-113.0] THE PRIEST (Ceremonial): "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..."
[L083 112.8-114.8] SCREEN: High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.
[L084 113.0-114.8] THE PRIEST (Off-Screen, Booming): "...husband and wife!"
[L085 114.0-115.2] SFX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[L086 114.8-116.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.
[L087 115.0-116.8] GERALD (Furious, Shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
[L088 116.8-119.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.
[L089 117.0-119.0] GERALD (Livid): "For a penniless nobody!"
[L090 119.0-122.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.
[L091 120.5-122.8] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[L092 122.8-125.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.
[L093 123.0-125.5] JULIANA (Firm, Final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[L094 125.8-127.4] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
[L095 126.0-127.4] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[L096 127.4-131.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.
[L097 127.5-131.5] LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[L098 131.5-134.8] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.
[L099 132.0-134.5] LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous): "You are disowned!"
[L100 134.8-136.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.
[L101 136.0-138.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.
[L102 138.8-140.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.
[L103 139.5-140.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective): "Come, Lady Juliana."
[L104 140.8-142.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.
[L105 142.8-144.8] SCREEN: Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.
[L106 144.8-146.5] SCREEN: Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.
[L107 145.0-146.5] ACTION: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
[L108 146.5-151.4] SCREEN: Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.
[L109 147.0-149.0] SFX: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.
[L110 147.5-151.4] ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
